_comment: Curated per-monster mechanics prose (wiki-verified at encode time; originally the MonsterNotes switch, moved to a token-free resource 2026-08-08 on Andrew's 'all of this data in json' call). A rule matches on lowercased monster name, optionally narrowed by versionStartsWith; ALL matching rules' notes concatenate.

rules.note: Each form prays a style away - crawling blocks magic and ranged, airborne blocks melee. Verac's set pierces the prayer (25% guaranteed hits, +1 damage); otherwise switch styles per form.
Only Strike spells damage him - a flat 9-12 set by your highest strike unlocked. Gear and damage bonuses do nothing; a Ring of recoil and dynamite(p) also work.
Three nibblers spawn every wave - one Ice Barrage cast clears the trio (a 152 xp drop means all three died). Bring the Ancient spellbook; Blood Barrage heals off packs once the wave is under control.
Blood or Ice Barrage is effective on the blob and its spawns.

Standard melee cannot damage the vents - halberds, ranged, or magic only. A demonbane hit (Scorching bow, Arclight...) destroys one instantly, and every hit lands for at least half your max. The four vents are spread out: ranged one-shots them all from one spot, so the melee numbers include the walk.
Disorient the Sire with a Shadow spell (Ancient spellbook - bring Ancients or Spellbook Swap), then kill the respiratory systems.
The spec dump: melee ALWAYS deals its max hit on the ejected core, and every hit counts x5 toward the Warden - unload multi-hit specs (claws, dragon dagger) in the 21-37 tick window.
Bring a recoil effect for the snakelings - Ring of recoil, Ring of suffering (r), or Echo boots. Hits above 50 are rerolled to 45-50.

Crumble Undead (39 Magic, standard book) is a guaranteed one-shot on the Zombified Spawn during the freeze phase - cast it before the spawn reaches you and explodes. A Slayer's staff makes it a left-click.

A witchwood icon partially blocks the screech, OR Protect from Melee nullifies it completely - with the prayer up, a dps necklace beats the icon. Their cave needs a light source (or a lit fire of eternal light).
Gargoyle: bring a rock hammer to finish it, or use the granite hammer (auto-smashes). Mostly immune to Magic.
Bring a rock hammer to finish it, or use the granite hammer (auto-smashes).
Bring a bag of salt to finish it.
Bring an ice cooler to finish it.
Bring fungicide spray to finish it.
The Karuulm Slayer Dungeon floor burns without boots of stone, brimstone boots, or granite boots - unless the Kourend & Kebos elite diary is complete.
The purple poison spawns explode for heavy damage - a full set of Shayzien armour (tier 5) blocks it; otherwise keep moving off the splatter.
Ring the slayer bell to knock a molanisk off the wall before it can be attacked.
Throw a fishing explosive at the ominous fishing spot to lure a mogre out.
